title: achillea alpina subsp. multiflora
intro: Achillea alpina subsp. multiflora, commonly known as Alpine Yarrow or multiflorous Alpine Yarrow, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe wounds, reduce fever, and alleviate digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory activities. By harnessing the bioactive properties of Alpine Yarrow, individuals may experience relief from various health conditions, making it a valuable addition to natural remedies and holistic treatments.
